description: The self-pay IVF cycle prices that US fertility clinics post on their own websites, for one state (optionally one city), with what each price includes, the clinic's own page as the source, and the date it was read. Clinics are listed by name, not ranked. Many clinics post no price; the answer says how many do.

city.description: Optional city to narrow the list (for example Houston).

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (TX) or its name (Texas). DC counts as a state here.

name: find_ivf_clinic_prices
title: IVF prices US clinics post
